reuse.why: Reuses getMonthActionCategories, setBudget, batchMessages and the undoable/mutator registration, but computes last month's spending with its own SQL instead of reading the existing per-month sum-amount-<category> sheet cells via getSheetValue as getCategoryAverage does.

duplication.why: The grouped SUM over v_transactions_internal_alive joined to on-budget accounts re-derives what base.ts already computes for the sum-amount cells, and the income-skip / sign-flip loop body repeats setMonthAverage.

placement.why: The action sits in budget/actions.ts beside the other month-wide actions and is registered in budget/app.ts like them, though transaction aggregation SQL belongs to the sheet layer in base.ts.

scope.why: Only the new action, its registration and its tests are added.

maintainability.why: A second definition of 'what a category spent in a month' can drift from the sheet's sum-amount cells (e.g. transfer or offbudget rules), which a maintainer would have to keep in sync.

bypasses_abstraction.where: actions.ts setLastMonthSpending queries v_transactions_internal_alive directly instead of getSheetValue(sheetForMonth(prevMonth), 'sum-amount-' + id).

disguised_duplication.where: The spending aggregation is reshaped as a single grouped query (similar to base.ts's sum-amount seeding query) rather than reusing the sheet cells; the per-category income-skip/negation loop mirrors setMonthAverage.
